# axiom_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Creates an API token whose value is never written to the Terraform state or plan.

A new token is created every time Terraform opens the ephemeral resource, which happens during each plan and each apply. By default the token is deleted when the run finishes, so it is only usable within that run, for example to configure another provider. To hand the token to a secret store through a write-only argument, set `delete_on_close` to `false` together with `expires_at`: tokens created by runs that do not store them then expire on their own.

Alternatively, set only `id` to the `id` of an `axiom_token_stateless` resource. No token is created in that case. Instead, `token` carries the value of the managed token during the apply that creates or regenerates it, and is an empty string in every other run, because the Axiom API returns a token value only once. Pass it to a write-only argument and change the version of that argument in the same apply that regenerates the token, so that the value is only written when a new one was issued. If that write does not complete, regenerate the token again to issue a new value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A token that only exists for the duration of the Terraform run.
ephemeral "axiom_token" "run" {
  name = "terraform-run"

  dataset_capabilities = {
    "application-logs" = {
      query = ["read"]
    }
  }
}

# A token that outlives the run so it can be handed to a secret store through
# a write-only argument. Its value is never written to the Terraform state.
# A new token is created by every plan and apply, so set expires_at to let
# the ones that are not stored expire.
ephemeral "axiom_token" "ingest" {
  name            = "application-ingest"
  expires_at      = "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  delete_on_close = false

  dataset_capabilities = {
    "application-logs" = {
      ingest = ["create"]
    }
  }
}

# The value of a long-lived token managed by the axiom_token_stateless
# resource, which does not keep it in the Terraform state. No token is created
# here: the value is carried during the apply that creates or regenerates the
# managed token, and is an empty string in every other run.
resource "axiom_token_stateless" "collector" {
  name = "otel-collector"

  dataset_capabilities = {
    "otel-logs" = {
      ingest = ["create"]
    }
  }
}

ephemeral "axiom_token" "collector" {
  id = axiom_token_stateless.collector.id
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `dataset_capabilities` (Attributes Map) The capabilities available to the token for each dataset (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataset_capabilities))
- `delete_on_close` (Boolean) Whether the token is deleted when the Terraform run finishes. Defaults to `true`. When `false`, `expires_at` is required because every plan and apply leaves a token behind
- `description` (String) The description of the token
- `expires_at` (String) The time when the token expires. Must be in RFC3339 format. Required when `delete_on_close` is `false`
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the token. Set it to the `id` of an `axiom_token_stateless` resource to read the value of that token instead of creating a new one. No other argument can be set together with `id`
- `name` (String) The name of the token. Required unless `id` is set
- `org_capabilities` (Attributes) The organisation capabilities available to the token (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--org_capabilities))

### Read-Only

- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token value to be used in API calls. When `id` is set, this is an empty string unless the referenced `axiom_token_stateless` resource was created or regenerated during the same apply

<a id="nestedatt--dataset_capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataset_capabilities`

Optional:

- `data` (List of String) Ability to manage the data in a dataset
- `ingest` (List of String) Ability to ingest into the specified dataset
- `query` (List of String) Ability to query the specified dataset
- `starred_queries` (List of String) Ability to perform actions on starred queries for the specified dataset
- `trim` (List of String) Ability to trim the data in a dataset
- `vacuum` (List of String) Ability to vacuum the fields in a dataset
- `virtual_fields` (List of String) Ability to perform actions on virtual fields for the provided dataset


<a id="nestedatt--org_capabilities"></a>

Optional:

- `annotations` (List of String) Ability to perform actions on annotations
- `api_tokens` (List of String) Ability to manage api tokens
- `audit_log` (List of String) Ability to read the audit log
- `billing` (List of String) Ability to manage billing information
- `dashboards` (List of String) Ability to manage dashboards
- `datasets` (List of String) Ability to manage datasets
- `endpoints` (List of String) Ability to manage endpoints
- `flows` (List of String) Ability to manage flows
- `integrations` (List of String) Ability to manage integrations
- `monitors` (List of String) Ability to manage monitors
- `notifiers` (List of String) Ability to manage notifiers
- `rbac` (List of String) Ability to manage roles and groups
- `shared_access_keys` (List of String) Ability to manage shared access keys
- `users` (List of String) Ability to manage users
